title: Coastal Soul Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Enviably located between the Alys and Rosemary Beach communities, this spacious third-floor condo overlooks The Village and 30A with glimpses of the sparkling emerald Gulf of Mexico.
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS. - Overlooking the town of Seacrest's shopping and dining - Smart TV's in each bedroom and living room - 2 adult sized beach cruisers - Community grill - Fully stocked kitchen - Private beach with seasonal tram service- condo located across the street from beach access - Easy stroll to Rosemary and Alys Beach shopping and dining - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) Located in The Village of South Walton in Seacrest Beach, Coastal Soul is your perfect upscale beach retreat. This 3-bedroom condo sleeps 8 and is located on the 3rd floor in building D, providing a bird’s eye view of 30A and even a little peek at the Gulf! Coastal Soul completely remodeled in 2022 with new furnishings, custom kitchen, designer spa master bath, and fresh coastal decor throughout. The sophisticated, open-concept feel to this condo makes for a welcoming and relaxing spot after a day on the beach. The kitchen is well equipped for all your meal and snack prep needs. There's seating for 4 at the bar and 6 more at the dining table, plus there is seating on the balcony for 4. VILLAGE OF SOUTH WALTON The Village has direct access to Sunset Beach and it's only a short walk away. Or, for your convenience, the seasonal tram will transport you to and from the beach. There are 2 large private pools at the Village with plenty of loungers and patio seating. Plus, there is a community grill area for your BBQ cravings. There are several dining options at the Village as well as shops and bike rentals all right at your fingertips. Right next door to the Village you can easily walk or bike to Rosemary Beach via the trail that parallels 30A. Rosemary Beach is a little piece of European flair in Florida. Have your pick of first-class dining options, one-of-a-kind boutiques, and picnic friendly green spaces. Hop in the car to head to Pier Park in Panama City Beach to the east, or make your way west to famous Seaside. Village of South Walton is the perfect location for your beach getaway to create memories that will last a lifetime. ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 8)- Elevator access to unit Bedroom 1: Master Suite- King bed, TV. sitting area, balcony access overlooking the central square. Private bathroom with dual sinks and extra-large shower- a true spa experience! Bedroom 2: Twin over Full Bunk with a Trundle Bed, TV, Sleeps 4 Bedroom 3: Queen bed, TV, Private access to the shared hall bath with tub/shower combo and dual sinks. * Sorry, no pets allowed. * Parking for 2 cars on first come first served basis * Pool access * Private beach access via the Seacrest Beach located across the street FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
